```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
scatter_path = data_dir / "sql_results" / "income_population_datacenter_query_results.csv"
line_path = data_dir / "sql_results" / "gdp_unemployment_air_query_results.csv"
```

```{python}
scatter_plot_df = pd.read_csv(scatter_path)

scatter_plot_df = scatter_plot_df.rename(columns={"avg_population": "Average Population"})

scatter_plot_df["log_data_center_count"] = np.log1p(scatter_plot_df["data_center_count"])

mean_income = scatter_plot_df["avg_personal_income"].mean()

plt.figure(figsize=(14,10))

sns.scatterplot(
  data = scatter_plot_df,
  x = 'avg_personal_income',
  y = 'log_data_center_count',
  size = 'Average Population',
  sizes = (20, 200),
  alpha = 0.5,
  edgecolor = None
)

plt.axvline(
    x=mean_income,
    color="lightcoral",
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=2,
    label=f"Mean Income: ${mean_income:,.0f}"
)

plt.text(
    mean_income,
    scatter_plot_df["log_data_center_count"].max() * 0.95,
    f"Mean Income: ${mean_income:,.0f}",
    color="lightcoral",
    fontsize=12,
    ha="center",
    va="top",
    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="white", edgecolor="lightcoral", alpha=0.7)
)

# Calculated from np.log1p
tick_vals = [0, 0.6931471805599453, 1.791759469228055, 2.3978952727983707, 3.9318256327243257, 4.61512051684126, 5.303304908059076]
tick_labels = [0, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 200]

plt.yticks(tick_vals, tick_labels)

plt.title(" Data Center Count vs. Per Capita Personal Income by County")
plt.xlabel("Per Capita Personal Income (Average Dollar Value from 2001-2022)")
plt.ylabel("Data Center Count (log-transformed)")
plt.grid(True, alpha = 0.3, linestyle="--")

plt.savefig("scatterplot_income_datacenters.png", dpi = 300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
lineplot_df = pd.read_csv(line_path)

lineplot_df = lineplot_df.rename(columns={
    "real_gdp": "Real GDP",
    "unemployment_rate": "Unemployment Rate",
    "average_air_quality_pm25": "Average Air Quality (PM25)"
})

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10))

sns.lineplot(
    data=lineplot_df,
    x="year",
    y="Unemployment Rate",
    ax=ax1,
    color="blue",
    label="Unemployment Rate"
)

sns.lineplot(
    data=lineplot_df,
    x="year",
    y="Average Air Quality (PM25)",
    ax=ax1,
    color="orange",
    label="Average Air Quality (PM25)"
)

ax1.set_title("Yearly Trends in GDP, Unemployment, and Air Quality")
ax1.set_xlabel("Year")
ax1.set_ylabel("Unemployment Rate / PM25")
ax1.ticklabel_format(axis='y', style='plain', useOffset=False)

ax2 = ax1.twinx()

sns.lineplot(
    data=lineplot_df,
    x="year",
    y="Real GDP",
    ax=ax2,
    color="green",
    label="Real GDP"
)
ax2.legend_.remove()

ax2.set_ylabel("Real GDP")
ax2.ticklabel_format(axis='y', style='plain', useOffset=False)

# Combine legends from both axes
handles1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
handles2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(handles1 + handles2, labels1 + labels2, title="")

plt.savefig("lineplot_gdp_unemployement_airquality.png", dpi = 300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
